name: Week 8 - infostealer adversary emulation plan
description: Safe, synthetic adversary emulation PLAN for Assignment 5 (week 8), derived from the Week 4 ACR Stealer Campaign 1 CTI. Weighted toward the Collection and Credential-Access behaviour that defines an infostealer; PowerShell is used only as the loader. This is a plan - nothing is executed yet. Green: planned. Amber: planned with a qualification (tactic note, access-pattern only, or extrapolation). Grey: documented, not planned (Campaign 1 exclusions, alternatives, anti-analysis). No attack code is executed in this planning increment.

techniques.comment: Stage A delivery. Local copy/paste command run manually on 127.0.0.1. QUALIFIED: ATT&CK classifies T1204.004 under Execution, not Initial Access.
Stage A. Lure and dropped marker named like a fake update; nothing signed or impersonated.
Stage B. cmd.exe launches the loader.
Stage B. PowerShell LOADER only - prints a marker and runs later steps. Collection behaviour is modelled separately in Stage E. Detections: Week 5 hunt, Weeks 6-7 CAR-2014-04-003.
Stage B. Base64-decode a benign marker command, as in Week 5.
Stage C. schtasks logon task runs a benign marker script; removed in cleanup. Detection: CAR-2013-08-001; needs Event 4698 audit policy.
Documented alternative, NOT executed. Run key is the more common stealer persistence; many stealers do not persist at all. Scheduled Task chosen because Campaign 1 reports it.
Stage D. Host fingerprint (systeminfo equivalent).
Stage D. User fingerprint (whoami equivalent).
Stage D. Locate the synthetic browser profile.
Stage D. Enumerate the lab folder before collection.
Stage E core. Read synthetic mock-browser.json. QUALIFIED: access pattern only - no DPAPI, no real store.
Stage E core (modern stealers). Read a synthetic cookies.json with a fake token. QUALIFIED: access pattern only.
Stage E. Read a synthetic wallet/config file with training values.
Stage E. Gather the synthetic files read above.
Stage E. Copy collected data into a staging folder.
Stage E. Compress-Archive packages the staged synthetic data.

Documented, not planned. Possible context only, not a confirmed Campaign 1 action: T1041 is exfiltration over an EXISTING C2 channel, while Campaign 1 supports data preparation (archiving) but not a completed transfer, and this lab has no C2 channel. The planned loopback POST is T1048.003 instead.

Documented, not planned. Possible context only, not a confirmed Campaign 1 action: web-protocol C2 communication. Campaign 1 supports contact with actor infrastructure, but this plan establishes no C2 channel, so this is not a planned step.

Stage F planned exfil - the closest ATT&CK match for a planned HTTP POST of the synthetic archive to a listener on 127.0.0.1, a transfer over an unencrypted protocol outside any C2 channel. Planned safe transfer of synthetic data, not performed exfiltration.

Documented, not planned. T1567.002 is cloud storage (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive); Telegram/Discord are T1567.004 (webhook) and paste sites T1567.003. The lab's loopback 127.0.0.1 transfer models none of these, so this is context only.
